   Plan: add double to a.ts

   Context

   /tmp/verify-repo/a.ts currently contains only export const x = 1;. We need a small exported helper double(n: number) that returns n * 2.

   Steps

   1. Edit /tmp/verify-repo/a.ts: append export function double(n: number): number { return n * 2; }, keeping the existing x export.
   2. Type-check the file (npx tsc --noEmit a.ts) to confirm it compiles.
   3. Sanity-check behavior, e.g. double(3) === 6, then commit if requested.

   Verification

   Type-check passes and double(3) returns 6.
